title: SpaceX's plan to fly you across the globe in 30 minutes | Gwynne Shotwell
summary: A TED conversation with SpaceX president Gwynne Shotwell about the company's race to put people in orbit and the BFR rocket. It also covers the idea of using the rocket for fast point-to-point travel on Earth.
why: Pointed to in SpaceX threads as a window into the company's ambitions and leadership.

quote.text: Another interesting watch is the TED talk by SpaceX COO Gwynne Shotwell earlier this year.
